lunch_start.name: {name}
lunch_start.text: *Lunchtime. Seoyeon heads for the stairs with her lunch bag. Dain waves from the school shop, while Yuna takes her book toward the library.*

lunch_start_4.name: {name}
lunch_start_4.text: *At the end of the hall, Seoyeon catches my eye and gestures toward the rooftop.*

lunch_start_4_b.name: {name}
lunch_start_4_b.text: *Dain grabs my arm from the side.*

lunch_start_5.name: Dain
lunch_start_5.text: Hey! Have you eaten yet? Let's hit the snack bar. Loser buys the bread!

lunch_start_6.name: {name}
lunch_start_6.text: *Yuna slips out of the classroom with only her bag and turns toward the library.*

lunch_start_7.name: {name}
lunch_start_7.text: *The hallway splits three ways. Rooftop, snack bar, library. Inside my pocket, the corner of my phone catches on my fingertips.*

lunch_choice.name: {name}
choices: Go to the school store with Dain

lunch_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_1.text: *She unlocks the rooftop door with her key. A gust of wind rushes in.*

lunch_seo_1_aff_high.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_1_aff_high.text: Sit. What you said in the hall earlier was pretty funny.

lunch_seo_2.name: {name}
lunch_seo_2.text: *There isn't a speck of dirt on the rooftop. Beside planters beaded with water, folding chairs line the wall at even intervals.*

lunch_seo_4.name: {name}
lunch_seo_4.text: The president gets her own rooftop?

lunch_seo_5.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_5.text: I don't bring just anyone up here. *She unfolds a chair.* Today is an exception.

lunch_seo_6.name: {name}
lunch_seo_6.text: VIP treatment on day one? Now I'm suspicious.

lunch_seo_6_b.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_6_b.text: *She nudges the chair into place in front of {name} with the tip of her foot.* Suspicious, aren't you? It's quiet up here.

lunch_seo_8.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_8.text: *She takes two same-size lunch containers from her bag, stacked together—enough for two.*

lunch_seo_10.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_10.text: I always pack extra. Council work keeps me busy, so I never know when I'll actually get to eat.

lunch_seo_11.name: {name}
lunch_seo_11.text: *She opens the lunchbox. Rolled omelette, sausages, and small rice balls sit in neat rows. There are two pairs of chopsticks.*

lunch_seo_14.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_14.text: It'd be embarrassing if the student council president couldn't even make her own lunch.

lunch_seo_16.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_16.text: *She hands me a pair of chopsticks.* Eat. It isn't good cold.

lunch_seo_17.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_17.text: *Instead of answering, Seoyeon takes a bite. Beyond the railing, the schoolyard and the roof of the annex spread out below.*

lunch_seo_21.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_21.text: *The tip of her chopsticks taps lightly against a divider in the lunchbox.* I asked about the school, and you answered with the food.

lunch_seo_22.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_22.text: *She picks up a piece of rolled omelette and holds it out.*

lunch_seo_choice.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_choice.text: *She holds out the piece of rolled omelette.*
choices: It'd taste better if you ate it yourself
You went to all that trouble, so I’ll have just one bite.
At this rate, I could ask you to make me lunch from now on.

lunch_seo_c1_1.name: {name}
lunch_seo_c1_1.text: *I take the rolled omelette from Seoyeon's chopsticks.*

lunch_seo_c1_2_b.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_c1_2_b.text: *She raises her water bottle to hide her mouth. The label crumples in her hand.*

lunch_seo_c1_3_b.name: {name}
lunch_seo_c1_3_b.text: *The half-crumpled label clings to the bottle. Seoyeon picks up her chopsticks again.*

lunch_seo_c2_1.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_c2_1.text: *She puts the rolled omelette into her own mouth. As she chews, the tip of her chopsticks taps against the lunchbox lid.*

lunch_seo_c2_3.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_c2_3.text: *She misaligns the corners of the lunchbox lid twice. It finally clicks shut on the third try.*

lunch_seo_after.name: {name}
lunch_seo_after.text: *A warning chime sounds over the field speakers, signaling the end of lunch.*

lunch_seo_after_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_after_2.text: Keep your lunch hour open next time, too.

lunch_seo_after_5.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_after_5.text: *She ties the lunchbox strap, then reties it tighter.*

lunch_seo_after_7.name: {name}
lunch_seo_after_7.text: *The knot around the lunchbox is tighter than before.*

lunch_seo_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
lunch_seo_freetalk.text: *She straightens the lunchbox lid and nudges the folding chair a few inches with the toe of her shoe.* Nice breeze, right?
lunch_seo_freetalk.context: First-day lunch, just after sharing Seoyeon's homemade bento on the rooftop. They are still getting to know each other, with some awkwardness and mutual curiosity between them.
lunch_seo_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is a composed student council president with a deliberate pace. She observes before showing interest and is honest in both speech and action.

lunch_dain_1.name: Dain
lunch_dain_1.text: Here we are! Snack bar. Pick something!

lunch_dain_1_aff_default.name: Dain
lunch_dain_1_aff_default.text: *The snack bar is packed at lunchtime. The smells of bread and milk mingle in the air.*

lunch_dain_2.name: Dain
lunch_dain_2.text: Soboro bread and strawberry milk. This combo's never failed me.

lunch_dain_3.name: {name}
lunch_dain_3.text: Hold on, you said loser buys. What's the game?

lunch_dain_6.name: Dain
lunch_dain_6.text: If you don't play, that means you're buying.

lunch_dain_12_b.name: Dain
lunch_dain_12_b.text: Ugh, fine! I'm buying. Two soboro buns, please!

lunch_dain_14.name: Dain
lunch_dain_14.text: *She slaps the coins onto the counter and takes the two soboro buns.*

lunch_dain_15.name: {name}
lunch_dain_15.text: *We sit on a bench by the school store and eat our bread.*

lunch_dain_16.name: Dain
lunch_dain_16.text: *She tears open the bread wrapper.* Hey, do you seriously not play any sports?

lunch_dain_18.name: Dain
lunch_dain_18.text: No. If you're going to hang out with me, I need to know you can keep up.

lunch_dain_19.name: {name}
lunch_dain_19.text: Thought this was about your PR.

lunch_dain_21.name: {name}
lunch_dain_21.text: Personal Record. It's a sports term.

lunch_dain_22.name: Dain
lunch_dain_22.text: *Her fingers dent the side of the strawberry milk carton.*

lunch_dain_23.name: Dain
lunch_dain_23.text: Oh, you know that? So you do know sports!

lunch_dain_choice.name: Dain
lunch_dain_choice.text: *Still biting the straw, she leans closer.*
choices: A little. Would you teach me?
I was just going along with it.

lunch_dain_c1_1.name: Dain
lunch_dain_c1_1.text: Good. Then come to the gym after school. We'll start with your warm-up. Deal?

lunch_dain_c1_2.name: {name}
lunch_dain_c1_2.text: *Dain's laugh rises above the noise of the school store. Her chair scrapes back, and she's already on her feet.*

lunch_dain_c2_1.name: Dain
lunch_dain_c2_1.text: You're at least curious, right? Come by the gym after school. You can just watch for a little while.

lunch_dain_after.name: {name}
lunch_dain_after.text: *We finish the bread and stand up.*

lunch_dain_after_4.name: Dain
lunch_dain_after_4.text: Your first meal at the new school, and I'm your dining partner? That's kind of historic.

lunch_dain_after_5.name: Dain
lunch_dain_after_5.text: *She gives {name}'s shoulder a light punch, shoves once with the same fist, then pulls away.*

lunch_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
lunch_dain_freetalk.text: *She folds the bread wrapper, stuffs it into her pocket, and leans back against the bench.* So, transfer student. First school store rating?
lunch_dain_freetalk.context: First-day lunch, just after a rock-paper-scissors bet with Dain at the school store. She lost and bought the bread. They have only begun getting to know each other.
lunch_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is an energetic volleyball player who often acts before she overthinks. She is candid and quick to respond, with competitiveness and kindness both part of her character.

lunch_yuna_1.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_1.text: *I follow Yuna into the library. Even though the lunch bell has already rung, the chair at the checkout desk sits empty and crooked.*

lunch_yuna_1_aff_default.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_1_aff_default.text: *There is no note. Yuna is already sitting in a corner of the reading room with a book open.*

lunch_yuna_2.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_2.text: *She opens a book in a corner of the reading room. When the chair opposite her scrapes the floor, her fingers tighten on the corner of the page.*

lunch_yuna_4.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_4.text: *A page turns. Yuna folds the end of her checkout receipt and tucks it beneath her bookmark.*

lunch_yuna_5.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_5.text: *Five seconds pass, then ten. Yuna only keeps folding the end of her checkout receipt. Not a single page turns.*

lunch_yuna_7.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_7.text: *She doesn't look up from her book.* If you can be quiet.

lunch_yuna_8.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_8.text: *Yuna reopens her book and pushes the bag on the opposite chair beneath the desk. I take the empty seat.*

lunch_yuna_10.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_10.text: *The ticking wall clock and the sound of turning pages trade places in the silence. The chair opposite her stays planted on the floor.*

lunch_yuna_10_b.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_10_b.text: *An old bookmark sits inside Yuna's book, her palm covering its faded writing. I pull a random book from the nearest shelf.*

lunch_yuna_12.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_12.text: *Her eyes rise above the spine of her book.* That's volume three.

lunch_yuna_14.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_14.text: You should start with volume one.

lunch_yuna_15.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_15.text: *Yuna slides a book from beside her toward me.*

lunch_yuna_17.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_17.text: Read it and give it back.

lunch_yuna_18.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_18.text: *Yuna opens her own book again. She leaves the one she lent me open to its first sentence.*

lunch_yuna_20.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_20.text: *The warning bell rings five minutes before class.*

lunch_yuna_22.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_22.text: *She slips in her bookmark.* For being quiet.

lunch_yuna_25.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_25.text: *Yuna puts her book away. Before getting up, she glances once more at the cover of the book I’m holding.*

lunch_yuna_choice.name: {name}
lunch_yuna_choice.text: *Yuna is only a few steps ahead. I pick up the book she left behind and hurry after her.*
choices: Is that book good? Should I read it too?
I guess you like sitting quietly with a book.
I’ll keep you more entertained than that book.
We could be comfortable together without having to talk.

lunch_yuna_c1_1.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_c1_1.text: Take your time with the first volume. It gets better as you go.

lunch_yuna_c1_2.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_c1_2.text: Let's talk when you're done. I want to know what you think.

lunch_yuna_c2_1.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_c2_1.text: Well, there's nothing else to do.

lunch_yuna_c2_2.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_c2_2.text: This library isn't bad, though. It's quiet.

lunch_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
lunch_yuna_freetalk.text: *She slips in her bookmark, closes the cover, and gestures to the chair opposite her with one palm.* You don't mind the quiet, do you?
lunch_yuna_freetalk.context: First-day lunch, just after spending a quiet stretch of time with Yuna in the library. They do not know each other well yet, but there is a quiet curiosity between them.
lunch_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is a reserved and cautious reader. She tends to observe and think before speaking, revealing more of her own thoughts as trust develops.

lunch_dain_trap_1.name: Dain
lunch_dain_trap_1.text: If you're not interested, just say so. I hate it more when people fake it.
